summary: Specification assistants already turn rough intent into reviewable requirements and task artifacts, but humans must still supply context and approve the resulting contract.

items.text: Kiro Specs expands a feature prompt into structured requirements, design, and implementation tasks, and explicitly lets the user review and refine each stage before coding. The staged artifact is a close implementation of LLM-mediated task shaping.

GitHub Copilot can create or update GitHub issues from natural-language instructions, using repository context to draft the title and body. The result remains an ordinary issue that a human can edit, label, discuss, and approve before assignment.

Taskade AI Project Studio turns a prompt and supplied resources into projects containing tasks, subtasks, and structured blocks. It is useful for converting an unstructured request into a reviewable work breakdown, though it does not guarantee requirements quality.

AI Acceptance Criteria for Jira converts issue descriptions or discussion context into discrete acceptance criteria inside Jira. Its narrow focus illustrates mediation at the contract boundary rather than asking a model to implement an underspecified request immediately.
